title: All hail your Worlds 2022 Champions!

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 4 champion buffs, 4 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: All hail your Worlds 2022 Champions! Structured changes across 25 entities this patch.
